_comment: Orbit's voice, in one place. Read by scripts/voice-config.mjs (which configures the ElevenLabs agent) and by src/agents/voiceConfig.ts (which renders speech for clients that cannot host a conversation). Two copies is how the voice silently reset to a default three times in one evening. ttsModel is turbo, not flash: flash commits to the start of a sentence before it knows the end, which is what made the agent sound clipped; turbo keeps the prosody for a delay nobody notices in a room (Jatin, PR #28).
